HECB.description: Element Convection Boundary (HECB). One record per element key holds an ITEMS array; each item binds an element face to a Convection Coefficient Function (CCFC) and an Ambient Temperature Function (ETFC), optionally grouped by a boundary group name.

ITEMS.description: List of element convection boundary definitions to assign under this element key. Each entry maps one face of the element to convection and ambient-temperature functions.

ID.description: Serial number of the item within this element key. If the (FACE_NO, GROUP_NAME) combination already exists, the matching record is replaced regardless of ID.

GROUP_NAME.description: Boundary group name. Optional; leave empty for no group. If non-empty it must reference an existing boundary group, otherwise the request is rejected.

FACE_NO.description: Element face number the convection boundary is applied to (Face#1 through Face#6).

CCFC_NAME.description: Name of the Convection Coefficient Function (CCFC). Must reference an existing convection coefficient function.

ETFC_NAME.description: Name of the Ambient Temperature Function (ETFC). Must reference an existing ambient temperature function.
